events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Three counties I've had this one's partner's sign. He's yours to flush and mine to finish -- don't lose him in the brush for me.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Driven off, not dead, and I didn't have to do it alone this time. Mark that down, it doesn't happen often.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: Steady pay and a straight answer about what this outfit actually does. That's more honesty than most paper I've carried. I'm in.

events.speaker: WILLOW
events.text: I've watched a lot of backs go bad on me. Yours hasn't yet. I'm allowed to notice that.
